name: Tribal Bond [Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
Your bond with your totem spirit increases around others of the same tribe.

Prerequisite(s): Totem Spirit, human.

Benefit(s): If at least one ally from the same tribe is within 30 feet, double your benefits from the Totem Spirit feat.
